question: Should Control accept this bounded SVG-capable authenticated proxy, or require every remote plugin icon to be rasterized entirely in the Gateway before reaching the browser?
rationale: Both designs avoid third-party browser origins, but they place SVG parsing and rasterization on different sides of the trust boundary; repository policy cannot select that permanent security ownership without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept bounded SVG proxy
options.body: Keep the proposed strict SVG grammar and browser rasterization after Gateway authentication, SSRF guarding, and byte limits.

options.title: Rasterize only in Gateway
options.body: Return PNG for every accepted icon and remove SVG parsing from the browser at the cost of requiring an available server-side image backend.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded SVG proxy
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed strict SVG grammar and browser rasterization after Gateway authentication, SSRF guarding, and byte limits.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent current-main work specifically hardened authentication on adjacent Control UI HTTP routes.
